newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices firm, volume jumps.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices firm, volume jumps.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange jumped to 1,480 kilos on Wednesday from 909 kilos on Tuesday on rising physical demand, dealers said.

Gold closed firmer at $350.00 an ounce and 1,411,500 lira per gram, against $348.55 and 1,407,600 lira on Tuesday. Prices rose in the afternoon session as a result of movements on European markets, dealers said.
"There was a continuation of phyical demand from yesterday coming from the free-market. Most of the deals took place in the morning, before prices rose later in the day," one dealer said.
Of the day's trade, 980 kilos were registered in the morning session and 500 kilos in the afternoon with 65.2 percent of trade conducted in lira terms.
